tz: dates are in the ad account timezone as returned by Meta
note: One entry per ACTIVE campaign; 'daily' holds one row per date with delivery (missing date = zero delivery). null means the metric family does not apply to this campaign objective (purchases=null for traffic, conversations=null for catalog sales, ...). A real zero stays 0. frequency = impressions/reach that day (null when reach=0). error!=null means the Meta fetch failed (expired/invalid token) — data may be stale. Definitions: purchases = Meta action type 'omni_purchase' (fallback 'purchase') — exactly the Ads Manager Purchases column; legacy offsite_conversion.* keys are excluded to avoid double counting. conversations = action type 'onsite_conversion.messaging_conversation_started_7d' (fallback 'messaging_conversation_started') — the Ads Manager 'Total messaging contacts' column.
error: meta api fetch failed: HTTP Error 400: Bad Request
